correctness.rationale: The channel reduces exactly to three-subsets of the four distinct nonconstant symbols. Complementing converts conflicts into intersection in two or more points among triples in a specific AGL(1,7) orbit. The 42 affine maps partition all 35 triples into orbits of sizes 21 and 14 with fibers 2 and 3. Exhaustive bitmask enumeration independently checks all 2^21 and 2^14 subfamilies and obtains packing maxima 6 and 7 with 14 and 2 maximizers. A separate recursive Python implementation agrees and checks all 49 codewords, 1176 pairwise channel relations in each orbit, omitted-triangle bijections, and realizable maximizing codes. All 7 constant words are independently compatible, yielding 13 and 14, and count multiplicity yields 14*2^6=896 and 2*3^7=4374. The finite computation proves this exact finite theorem; no extrapolation to other fields.
